dialogues.speaker: Grainville
dialogues.text: It's you! You maintained order in the production zone.

dialogues.speaker: Grainville
dialogues.text: Maintaining a sanitary environment is part of maintaining order, so we thank you for your contributions to the production zone. These Credit Coupon are a well-deserved reward. Please, take them.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You hear someone calling, so you leave the water...
